utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout already—people are dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you want, I can swing by and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure they still need anything? If you swing by, can you confirm what’s missing?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll swing by and check what’s missing, then I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out, though I might miss a few updates.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, I’ll keep repeating it around the block so nobody misses it. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive — what do you need done first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — could you start by sorting the donated tools and checking what’s still missing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll sort the donated tools and make a quick list of what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard much yet, but I’m glad the repair drive is happening. If you want, I can help spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Rey — I’ve got a few supplies to round up, and more eyes on the block would really help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. Just tell me what you need me to share, and I’ll mention it to folks nearby.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school run, but I’ll need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair drive details over now, including the timing, the drop-off point, and what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, send it over and I’ll work it around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll line up the next step.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—mostly the loose fence gate and that porch light that keeps flickering. If you can help line up someone to take a look, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can do that—I'll line up someone to check the gate and porch light. If you want, I can also help set a day and time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m already telling folks about it—want me to pass your name along too?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please—just make sure they know I’d need the time and place a bit ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll make sure they know you need the time and place ahead of time. I’ll send your name along too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard a little second-hand, but I’m glad folks are organizing it. Let me know what I should bring or where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — that’s really kind. I’ll send the time and place, and if you can bring gloves or a strong bag, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, I can do that. Just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the date, time, and what kind of repairs the drive supports? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I just need to confirm the exact date and time, plus which repairs we’re covering, and I’ll share the full details with you right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’m ready when you’ve got the exact date, time, and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I’ll need to keep it brief today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Totally fine—I just appreciate you jumping in, even briefly. We can keep it quick and get you the details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Just give me the main details and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Gus. What time should I expect you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can swing by around 4 this afternoon with the toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep an eye on where the repair drive is happening and let you know the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Opal — just let me know the exact spot when you find it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — I’ll check and tell you the exact spot as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll let you know what tools we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course — I’m glad to help. Just send me the list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and where everything needs to go first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure — I can confirm the timing and the drop-off spot before we go any further.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that would help a lot. Once you have the timing and drop-off spot, I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I can help connect folks and spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — that’d be a huge help. I’ll send you the details and a short blurb you can share.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll share it around.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what we’ve got and let you know what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — that’d be really helpful. I may be a bit late, but I can still bring something once I know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, Dane — I’ll check what’s missing and let you know soon so you can bring whatever helps most.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s getting a decent turnout already—folks are dropping off tools and cash by the hour. If you’re heading over, I can walk with you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be lovely, Tess—thanks. I can swing by after I finish up with the kids’ school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, I’ll meet you after pickup and we can head over together. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — could you help me organize the tool list and check who’s available this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can do that — I’ll organize the tool list and check who’s free this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you handle sorting the donated tools and setting them aside by size?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated tools and set them aside by size.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling everyone about the repair drive — if you want, I can put your name on the helper list too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks — I’ve heard a little about it, but I’m not sure what all needs doing yet. Put me down if you still need an extra set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll add your name, and I’ll make sure you get the details on what needs doing. Thanks, Nell!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye on the repair drive location and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. Please let me know if the location changes, and I’ll follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: You’re welcome, Eli—I’ll keep watching the repair drive location and tell you right away if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive get enough volunteers, or do you still need help?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I should check the latest sign-up list before I answer, but I can tell you as soon as I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—please check and let me know. If you still need help, I can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds good—I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira—much appreciated. If you hear anything, just let me know and I’ll come by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Oren. If I hear any updates, I’ll let you know right away.
